decisions.reason: The product has achieved a major market share, so the option's value is likely realized and it is kept.
After four years with no visible market traction and some overlap with the box cooler system, the option's value appears unlikely, so it is dropped.
As a component with low keeping cost and ongoing internal use, the option is retained while uncertainty resolves.
Similarly, the enhanced tube option remains inexpensive to keep and may still prove valuable, so it is retained.
